bias_warning: Current universe and current taxonomy are retrospectively applied; hypothesis validation only.

design.baseline: Day0 signal close -> next open buy RS63 top3, equal one-third weights, hold to terminal
design.wait: stay in cash until Day1/2/3/5 close, then next open buy positive Theme-relative top N
design.prune: buy baseline RS3 on Day0->next open; at specified day close sell only names with cumulative Theme-relative return <=0 at next open; no reallocation
design.prune_2neg: sell an initial RS3 name only after two consecutive closes with cumulative Theme-relative return <=0 during Days1-5; no reallocation
design.candidate_pool: same Day0 price/liquidity/EMA21/SMA50 eligible pool as prior validation
